# dev-v2

80 synthetic development cases for policy version 3 (drafted as base version 2): 40 NO_SHOW_CHARGE (1701-1740) and 40 ROUTE_DEVIATION
(1751-1790), schema 1.2.0 with the version-2 optional fields (`trip_record.platform_policy` on every no-show record,
`scheduled_at`, `events[]`, `dispute.safety_flag` / `complaint_flag`). No case number, dispute id or evidence id is used
by any other set in the repository.

This directory holds only what an agent may see: the cases, `index.json` (case_no, dispute_id, trip_id, category, file,
sha256), `split.json` (calibration and holdout case numbers), `CANARY.txt` (a marker that must never reach a prompt,
a policy file, a precedent or another set's run) and this note. The key, the per-case table, the pairs, the scenario
manifest, the datasheet and the long README are under `eval/answers/dev-v2/`, because they describe outcomes.

Generated by `eval/synth/make_dev_set.py` (seed 20261007); checked by `eval/synth/verify_dev_set.py`; tested by
`tests/test_dev_v2.py`. Development data: never a generalisation figure.
